text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during the middle of summer
camp...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Phew... How was that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's performance has been on
point recently. I'm positive she'll show
great improvement by the end of the
summer training
camp.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my,
it's already this late. Time flies
when you're focusing hard.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I'm feeling really good lately.
Even though I've already hit
today's
targets,
I feel like I could keep running. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right.
We've still got plenty of
time left at camp.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
it's nothing. I was just thinking how
productive I was today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm really taking to the plan
you
created for me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I shouldn't be surprised. You thought
about all my needs when you
made it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I think it's time to give
you
a reward for all your hard
work! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ♪ There's a summer festival not far
from here. Would you be
interested in
going with me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After gladly accepting her invitation, we
head off to the festival.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, there are so many kids here. It's so
nice to see everyone having
fun!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we take a look at the
stalls ourselves? ...But there are
so many—I
don't know where to begin.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and of course, we should get some
food after all that training.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's buy something, find a place with a
nice view, and dig in. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek and I mill around, buying an
assortment of fun things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The festival gradually becomes more and
more packed as dusk turns
to night.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people here now. Let's
try not to get separated...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as Creek finishes her sentence,
she finds herself getting
swept away in the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh! Oh my!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer! We should—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I grab Super Creek's hand tightly and
manage to lead us to an open
area.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I think we'll be fine over here. It was
getting really bad back there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I'm glad we were able to hold hands
and not lose each other.
Hehe... ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking down, I realize that our hands are
still together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I quickly let go of her hand.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe,
there's no need to get all flustered.
You were the one who told
me to take
your hand.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, did I?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
we can talk later. The takoyaki is
getting cold.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While eating takoyaki, we gaze at the
night ocean illuminated by the
moon and
stars.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We sit together quietly, with only the
sounds of the waves marking
the passage
of time. Finally, Super Creek breaks the
silence.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: About that moment earlier...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... when you asked me to take your
hand.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually I... was going to say the same
thing, but you beat me to it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The way you reached out to me... I felt that you were so dependable.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, definitely. You've already grown so
much since the day we met.
I'm really
proud of you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Creek looks at me gently, a strong
motivation swells up inside of
me. The only
thing that I want to do is keep working
hard for her.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I know this is a serious moment right now,
but you've got takoyaki
sauce on your
face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Embarrassed, I quickly stick my hand in my
pocket for my
handkerchief. But before I
can pull it out...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Stop! Don't move—just a second.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek quietly wipes the corners of
my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...There we go. All clean now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you remember when you asked
me if there was anything I
wanted from
you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I think I know now. Would you like to
hear?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
By gaining more and more experience, I
know that you'll become an
even greater
trainer than you already are.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how much you grow... will
you still let me take care of
you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Thank you. It means a lot to me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And I hope that we'll continue to spend
lots and lots of time together.
